title: [3.0-beta11] Watchface commands (e.g. TempT) do not work.
body:
AAPS 3.0-beta11 Build d145b9c7e
Samsung Galaxy S9 (SM-G960F)
Android 10 One UI 2.5
TicWatch Pro with the newest Wear OS

When  trying to give any command from the watchface (e.g. TempT) an empty display comes with a text  "Title".
The result is that the intended command does not go into AAPS.
The problem was already in earlier dev versions between beta9 .. beta10 so it is not a new problem of beta11.
